notes:
Fake-only gate pass for gh.ice-mao/rl_auv_tracking at 8ff39512f796801aa461fa074f7972e3a4e3a81f. The card's family/helper (gymnasium/GymnasiumDriver) matches the upstream runtime: auv_env.envs.base:TargetTrackingBase is a gym.Env, and the driver serves AUVTracking_v0 with the shipped configs/envs/v0_config.yml defaults (WorldAuvV0, PID, 2-element Box [-1,1], 1 target, 6-element state observation). The last gate run printed digest sha256:171f8d2370c05083cea083c05e18c06961962114ab13cf4ea1b4fd9b682a454f and zero failed checks. The two remaining warning codes are the bridge-derived ones the exemplar also leaves: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only stages the next reset, no native call) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the integer seed/ticks and the unitless action.values the Gymnasium bridge derives (the step action is a normalized simulator action, not a physical unit). NOT COVERED: the live HoloOcean environment was never run or compared with the fake. There is no sim backend: every gym.register call in the clone is commented out (auv_env/__init__.py:125-129), env_id is unset, and the real constructor needs HoloOcean 2.0.0, the HoloOcean Ocean packages and the configs/holoocean scenarios copied into the HoloOcean worlds directory (README.md:48-53), none of which is installed; the real factory auv_env.make is cited in facts.md but package code never imports the clone. The only backend that exists is the package's analytic F0 fake (.fake:FakeAuvTrackingV0), which has no HoloOcean physics, PID/LQR controller, KF belief, ocean current, sonar, camera or obstacles; the target is static and the poses, covariance, rewards and motion are analytic stand-ins (marked placeholder in fake.py). The upstream reset reseeds numpy from entropy (auv_env/envs/base.py:47 and :463), so an upstream seed does not fix a trajectory; the fake honors reset(seed) for its own repeatable tests only, and fidelity says so. The upstream sampling period comes from the HoloOcean scenario ticks_per_sec (base.py:78) and is not fixed in the clone, so the fake reports timestep_ms 0 and one abstract step per tick. The package covers AUVTracking_v0 only; AUVTracking_v1/v2, the 3D worlds and the LQR/keyboard controllers are not covered. No hardware, network, upstream install or clone import was used; reviewed_by stays null and the package is model-authored and unreviewed, so no hardware or real-ROS/HoloOcean run is claimed.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review confirmed the factory, concrete Gymnasium class and shipped v0 PID action Box against the pinned clone. Edited driver.py and facts.md to narrow registration, seed and truncation facts, identify belief-relative observations, correct controller coverage, scope the latch to fake state, and disclose unbounded reset sampling and stdout. Corrected test_driver.py wording and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The fake gate and strict collector pass; no live HoloOcean construction or stop was tested. For the human reviewer: Only the fake contract was tested. A live adapter would need bounded initial-pose sampling, stdout isolation and simulator lifecycle handling; no native HoloOcean stop is provided. Upstream reset reseeds from entropy, so fake seeded repeatability is not live evidence. Root LICENSE is GPL-3.0; no publication decision was made.
